title: University of Rochester Academic Grade Appeal Procedure

steps.label: Review Syllabus Guidelines
steps.description_plain: Check course syllabus or instructor guidelines for specific appeal rules.
steps.source_sentence: If a student believes that an error in grading has been made, they should follow the guidelines provided in the syllabus or by the instructor for a grade appeal.

steps.label: Discuss with Instructor
steps.description_plain: Approach faculty member promptly to discuss the grading concern.
steps.source_sentence: If specific guidelines are not provided, students are encouraged to approach the faculty member as soon as possible after the grade is received to discuss the matter.

steps.label: Instructor Determination
steps.description_plain: Professor corrects grading error or explains reasoning.
steps.source_sentence: If the professor determines that a grading error was made, the professor will be responsible for correcting the error.

steps.label: Submit Formal Complaint Form
steps.description_plain: Submit complaint form if no satisfactory resolution is reached.
steps.source_sentence: In the event that a satisfactory resolution cannot be reached, a student has the option to request a formal review of the matter by submitting a complaint form.

steps.label: Appeal to Dean of the College
steps.description_plain: Appeal to college dean if unsatisfied with review outcome.
steps.source_sentence: If the student submitting the complaint or comment form is not satisfied with the outcome of the review, the student may appeal the decision to the dean of the College.

gaps.description: Procedure if instructor is on leave, retired, or unresponsive to email
